verdict.rationale: Kushki markets 'Kajita de pagos' as a customizable payment form and offers kushki.js, a JS library for PCI-secure card capture used in its 3DS integration. This is distinct from its redirect-based 'Botón de pagos' hosted portal, so the core story of embedding customizable payment components in your own site is covered. Evidence is mostly product-page titles with little depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Kajita/kushki.js customization options (styling, fields, events), mobile SDK or in-app embedding evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
